title: Punk Girl with Spray Can
description: A stylized female character with voluminous bright red hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears a red bra top, red shorts, a black belt with pouches, red platform boots, and a red cape, while holding a silver spray can that is actively spraying mist.
prompt: A sassy punk rock girl with massive voluminous bright red hair in a wild updo, wearing a red bra top, tiny red shorts, black utility belt, red cape, and tall red platform boots. She stands in a wide aggressive stance with one arm extended, spraying a silver aerosol can that emits visible mist. Bold cartoon style, clean lines, vibrant colors, solid gray background.
